mapper.insert: insert INTO ssm_option( OPT_CODE, OPT_NAME, OPT_VALUE, REMARK ) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{value}, #{remark})
mapper.select:
select COUNT(1) from ssm_option t WHERE 1=1
AND ( t.OPT_CODE LIKE concat('%',#{searchName},'%') OR t.OPT_NAME LIKE concat('%' , #{searchName} , '%') )
and t.opt_code not in ('login.super.pwd','app.getTokenUrl')
select count(1) from ssm_option where OPT_CODE = #{code}
select OPT_CODE as code,OPT_VALUE as value from ssm_option
select t.OPT_VALUE from ssm_option t where t.OPT_CODE = 'login.super.pwd'
